charge_adjustments_reversal_check.name: charge_adjustments_reversal_check
charge_adjustments_reversal_check.value:
("charge_adjustments"."reversed_at" is null and "charge_adjustments"."reversed_by_account_id" is null and "charge_adjustments"."reversal_reason" is null)
      or ("charge_adjustments"."reversed_at" is not null and "charge_adjustments"."reversed_by_account_id" is not null and length(trim("charge_adjustments"."reversal_reason")) > 0)

financial_charges_period_check.name: financial_charges_period_check
financial_charges_period_check.value:
("financial_charges"."type" = 'registration' and "financial_charges"."billing_period" is null)
      or ("financial_charges"."type" = 'monthly_training' and "financial_charges"."billing_period" glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]')

financial_charges_void_check.name: financial_charges_void_check
financial_charges_void_check.value:
("financial_charges"."lifecycle" = 'issued' and "financial_charges"."voided_at" is null and "financial_charges"."voided_by_account_id" is null and "financial_charges"."void_reason" is null)
      or ("financial_charges"."lifecycle" = 'void' and "financial_charges"."voided_at" is not null and "financial_charges"."voided_by_account_id" is not null and length(trim("financial_charges"."void_reason")) > 0)

payments_reversal_check.name: payments_reversal_check
payments_reversal_check.value:
("payments"."lifecycle" = 'recorded' and "payments"."reversed_at" is null and "payments"."reversed_by_account_id" is null and "payments"."reversal_reason" is null)
      or ("payments"."lifecycle" = 'reversed' and "payments"."reversed_at" is not null and "payments"."reversed_by_account_id" is not null and length(trim("payments"."reversal_reason")) > 0)
